title: Verifiable Intent mandate pair state held by the network

states.label: Unfulfilled
states.note: L2 Autonomous signed; no L3 pair accepted yet.

states.label: Fulfilled
states.note: One L3a and L3b pair accepted (base model).

states.label: Recurring (agent_recurrence)

states.label: Exhausted
states.note: max_occurrences, budget max or end_date reached.

states.label: Expired
states.note: L2 exp passed; the user should be prompted to authorize again.
